item.description: President Trump has said that the execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad will not be livestreamed. The announcement of the public execution by Pete Hegseth received criticism from across the political spectrum, including VP Vance who said he was "not going to be watching it."
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

President Trump has said that the execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad will not be livestreamed. The announcement of the public execution by Pete Hegseth received criticism from across the political spectrum, including VP Vance who said he was "not going to be watching it."

item.description: We have mapped attacks on merchant vessels in the Black Sea which have grown more common and have shifted further west since July. Yesterday the first attack occurred on a vessel within a NATO member's territorial sea. Today WINE TRADER was struck, also within the 12NM zone.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

We have mapped attacks on merchant vessels in the Black Sea which have grown more common and have shifted further west since July. Yesterday the first attack occurred on a vessel within a NATO member's territorial sea. Today WINE TRADER was struck, also within the 12NM zone.
